heroLead: Shanor-Northvue sits just outside the city of Butler, a mix of older residential streets and land that was farmland within living memory, where mineral ownership questions come up more often than most people expect for a place this close to town.
intro: Being close to a county seat doesn't mean mineral rights here have been sorted out cleanly — if anything, the mix of older residential lots and remnant farm parcels around Shanor-Northvue makes title work more important, not less. We take the time to trace exactly what you own before making an offer.

sections.heading: Suburban Growth Around Butler and What It Means for Minerals
paragraphs: As the area around Butler has grown, farmland has given way to residential development in stages, and mineral rights reservations from those transitions vary from tract to tract. Some Shanor-Northvue parcels retained mineral rights with the original farm family, others transferred everything together. We check your specific deed to determine which applies.

Butler County overall has solid wet-gas Marcellus activity, and proximity to the county seat doesn't reduce that potential, though we still check unit boundaries against your specific parcel before quoting a number.

sections.heading: A Clear Process From Start to Finish
paragraphs: We pull your recorded deed from the Butler County recorder of deeds, confirm your fractional interest, check nearby activity, and give you a straightforward offer, with no pressure to accept before you've had time to think it over.

faqs.question: My family's farm became a residential neighborhood decades ago. Did we keep the mineral rights?
faqs.answer: It depends on how the property was transferred at the time. We check the recorded deed language to confirm what your family retained, if anything.

faqs.question: Is Shanor-Northvue too developed for gas activity to matter?
faqs.answer: No, mineral rights under developed land still hold value based on proximity to active units, separate from surface development.

faqs.question: How long do I have to decide on an offer?
faqs.answer: There's no deadline pressure from us. Take the time you need to review the offer and ask questions.

faqs.question: Can you value an interest even if part of the original farm is now commercial property?
faqs.answer: Yes, mixed residential and commercial development above doesn't change the underlying mineral ownership, and we evaluate the interest the same way regardless of current surface use.

faqs.question: Is Shanor-Northvue's closeness to Butler city a meaningful factor in value?
faqs.answer: It's less about proximity to town and more about proximity to an active drilling unit, which we check specifically for your parcel rather than relying on general location.
